project.name: geppio
project.summary: Windows-first local workbench with continuous regional geometry, host organization/compositions and trusted local plugins; modular IDE and Windows/Linux product direction remain future scopes beyond current Windows validation.

constraints: Product name GeppIO; technical namespace geppio; Canonical GitHub repository rabrunos/GeppIO, stable repository ID 1409287329 (Issue #6).

No mandatory GeppIO login, external service or paid AI API in the current desktop. Optional community identity (#34) and provider-specific authentication belong to separately authorized future scopes.
The alpha.1 foundation used static fixtures; alpha.2 added trusted experimental local plugins (Issue #21). No native terminal or secure untrusted-plugin platform is implemented.
No BootCrate Setup, Console, raw intake or upstream application code.

Completed, validated approved GeppIO Issues inherit standing commit/push authorization under TASK_POLICY after repository ID/origin/main/staged-diff verification; explicit task overrides apply. Issue metadata/closure and publication require separate authority.

Retain Electron for the owner-recorded Windows/Linux direction; platforms currently records validated Windows x64 scope, not delivered Linux support. Linux runtime smoke/packaging and distribution remain unverified/unimplemented.
Issue #8 selects the canonical shadcn/ui source for needed components, not arbitrary registries/dependencies; no identifiable integration is claimed in the current toolchain.

New deliberate external-library or copied/adapted source adoption requires individual owner approval under Issue #19 and TASK_POLICY. Existing chosen stack is not retroactively unapproved; transitive nodes receive normal graph review rather than separate approval per node.
architecture_invariants: The prototype represents Sidebar, Main and Bottom as siblings; the owner discussion about the final abstraction remains open.

Continuous CSS-pixel geometry across Main/Sidebar/Bottom; bounded default, optional content-bounded horizontal expansion, stable-source reversible projection and no viewport-only layout writes (Issue #29). Historical grid data remains preserved.
Individual widget movement/resize requires explicit Edit mode; adjacent-pair resize can commit through its own validated normal-mode transaction. Viewport projection alone never persists geometry.
Presentation, anchor and collapsibility remain independent concepts.

A plugin is not equivalent to a widget; trusted local packages run in disposable Web Workers with declarative widgets and lifecycle limits. This experimental runtime is not secure isolation for untrusted plugins.
No Node, filesystem or generic IPC exposed to the renderer.
Host catalog, model/view identities, bars, compositions, reservations and session undo/redo do not extend manifest v1 authority. Local plugin widgets remain declarative Main-only single-view cards.

The active host registry has seven synthetic widget types, initially four Main, two Sidebar and one Bottom. Display project names/Git indicators/profile and the presentation panel are demonstrations, not filesystem/Git/accounts/terminal implementations.
Workbench layout/organization persistence, session history and plugin-owned data are different scopes. Session history is not persisted; a composition does not persist plugin content.

untrusted_inputs: Local plugin manifests, installed package/state bytes and Worker messages (validated inputs; executable plugins must still be trusted)
